captions.detailed: This object is a pair of giant observation porro-prism binoculars mounted on a robust fork pedestal. The binoculars feature two large, dark-colored cylindrical barrels with dark blue objective lenses, connected by a central hinge, with rectangular prism housings near the eyepieces. The entire optical assembly is supported by a U-shaped mounting fork featuring grey circular adjustment knobs on the sides. The pedestal consists of a vertical support column with a grey cylindrical collar near the middle, anchored to a flat circular base. The binoculars can tilt up and down on a horizontal pivot, and the entire fork mount can pan horizontally on the vertical stand.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a pair of giant observation porro-prism binoculars on a fork mount pedestal. The model should feature dual cylindrical optical barrels with rectangular prism housings, a central hinge mechanism, a U-shaped mounting fork with side adjustment knobs, and a vertical support column on a circular base. Ensure appropriate revolute joints are defined for the horizontal pan of the fork and the vertical tilt of the binoculars.
captions.factory: The script constructs the model through modular parts and joints. It starts by building the base and vertical stand using cylinder primitives. A U-shaped fork is constructed with box segments (horizontal bar and vertical arms) and connected to the stand via a revolute pan joint. The binoculars are built from cylinders for the objective barrels and eyepieces, combined with boxes for the prism housings, and joined together via a central hinge. This entire binocular assembly is connected to the fork arms with a revolute tilt joint, incorporating cylindrical clutch knobs on the sides.
